headlines.text: Nvidia reports fiscal Q3 results after today's close in Colette Kress's first earnings call as interim CEO since Jensen Huang's exit, with Wall Street eyeing a $108B revenue guide
Nasdaq sinks 2.5% and Dow drops 1.4% Monday in Wall Street's worst one-day decline since Nov. 5, as chip and AI stocks lead the slide into Nvidia's report
Anthropic sets IPO price range at $70-$78 a share, valuing the AI firm up to $1.4 trillion ahead of its planned Thursday Nasdaq debut under 'ANT'
Fed's October FOMC minutes, due out Wednesday, expected to show a divided committee doubtful of a December rate cut
Commerce Department nears a rule to block China's remote access to Nvidia's advanced AI chips through data centers in other countries, report says
